description: Search Lezzoo for restaurants/stores near a location. Results are ranked by relevance and proximity, so location matters: pass the user's latitude/longitude when known. If location is unknown, the user's area/address can be used to derive it; otherwise a configured default location applies. Returns restaurants as cards (when the host supports MCP Apps). Use a returned merchant's `merchant_id` with `search_merchant_products` to open its menu. Anonymous — no sign-in or account is required. Read-only.

city.description: City to scope results. Defaults server-side.

departmentId.description: Optional department id to scope to one vertical (e.g. Food, Grocery, Pharmacy).

language.description: Result language: en, ar, kr, bd.

latitude.description: User latitude (-90..90). Ask the user if unknown; falls back to the server default.

longitude.description: User longitude (-180..180). Falls back to the server default.

name: search

merchants.description: Matched restaurants/stores as cards (each has merchant_id, name, …).

summary.description: Result summary: merchant_count, tags, truncated, note.

title: Search restaurants & products
